run_pyright_local: run pyright type checking on the current repo excluding untracked files using a local config
run_pyright_with_git_status: run pyright and automatically exclude all untracked git files from type checking
run_pyright_ci_config: run pyright using the CI config extended with locally untracked file exclusions
run_pyright_temp_config: run pyright with a temporary config file that excludes untracked files then cleans up
run_pyright_exclude_untracked: run pyright type checker while excluding all untracked files from the git working directory
